action.description: Action to perform: list_cogs(list all cogs), list_commands(list all cogs and their commands), search(search cog/command names by keyword), get_command_info(get detailed info of a specific command)

keyword.description: Search keyword, matches against cog names and command names (only needed for search action)

command_name.description: Command name (only needed for get_command_info action)
